votes.motion: Approve the variance of septic offset to a property line at 90 West Townsend Road, from 50 feet to approximately 25 feet.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by passios and secon d by jewell, the variance of offset to property lin e from 50 feet to approximately 25 feet was approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 223 Pleasant Street (sieve analysis, groundwater offset from 4 feet to 2 feet, and septic tank-to-cellar distance from ten feet to six feet).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by passios, the variances were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Grant the request to keep the second shallow well at 466 W. Townsend Road, with the stated conditions (one spigot, deed notice that the well is for irrigation only).
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the request to keep the second shallow well was granted with the above conditions. all in favor.

votes.motion: Grant the variances requested for 727 West Street (groundwater offset from four feet to three feet and a sieve analysis).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by passios, the variances were requested. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 570 Leominster Road (groundwater offset from 4 feet to 3 feet).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the variances were approved. all in favor.
